top_signals.title: ECB's Vujcic Says December Rate Hike Looks 'Very Likely'
top_signals.summary: European Central Bank Vice President Boris Vujcic says a December rate hike looks highly probable and more increases may follow in 2027 as inflation broadens. He made the comments during an interview with Bloomberg's Mark Schroers. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Gold Slumps Below $3,800 as Fed Officials Signal More Rate Hikes
top_signals.summary: Gold dropped below $3,800 an ounce for the first time since September 2025 after Federal Reserve officials made the case for more interest-rate hikes to tackle stubborn inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Oil Prices Drop Despite Escalating U.S.-Iran Conflict
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices extended their decline today, following the Tuesday release of the American Petroleum Institute oil stock report, which showed a build across crude and fuels. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $92.49 per barrel, with West Texas Intermediate at $84.73 per barrel, both down sharply from a month ago when Brent crude was trading at over $100 per barrel, and WTI was at over $98. The American Petroleum Institute estimated that crude oil inventories in the United States rose by 5.3 million barrels in the week ending November…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Global energy watchdog warns ‘no credible way’ back to pre-Iran war energy markets
top_signals.summary: The boss of the global energy watchdog has warned there is “no credible pathway” back to the energy market as it stood before the disruption caused by the Iran war. Fiath Birol, the executive director of the International Energy Agency, said risks of further blockages to flows through the Strait of Hormuz could happen again [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Lowe's posts strong online sales, raises outlook despite slow housing market
top_signals.summary: Lowe's said it saw strength in online sales during its quarter that contributed to a guidance raise for the full year.
